app.title: Mumble Web
app.description: Join your Mumble voice space in the browser. Low latency, one-link invites, no install.

connect.heroBody: Join a Mumble server right in the browser. Low latency, no client install.
connect.brandSubtitle: Your voice space in the browser
connect.footer: Join your Mumble voice space in the browser.
connect.featureLowLatencyBody: Jump into a channel and talk without the desktop app.
connect.featureInviteBody: Send a link and let people join in one click.
connect.featureNoInstallBody: Works on desktop and mobile for quick conversations.
connect.title: Connect to your voice space
connect.description: Enter a name to join your Mumble server.
connect.inviteDescription: The server and password are set by the person who invited you.
connect.inviteNotice: This invite is valid. Server details come from the invite.
connect.usernameHint: A name can only be online in one place.
connect.serverHelp: Leave empty to use the server configured at deploy time.
connect.portInvalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
connect.invalidInviteBody: Invites are single-use and time-limited. Ask the sender for a new one.
connect.proxyUnavailable: Could not reach the proxy server

chat.emptyBody: No messages yet. Say hello. You are here as {{name}}.
chat.imageTooLarge: The image is too large even after compression

lightbox.title: Image viewer
lightbox.hint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan

session.takeoverBody: A Mumble name can only be online in one place. This session has been paused and will not reconnect automatically.
session.usernameInUseTitle: That name is already in use
session.usernameInUseBody: Use a different name. This name is currently used by another client.
session.kickedTitle: You were removed from the server
session.kickedBody: The server ended your session. You can rejoin or use a different name.
session.bannedTitle: You are banned from this server
session.bannedBody: This name cannot rejoin. Contact the server administrator.
session.flapBody: The session connected and dropped several times in a row. This can happen with a duplicate name or a server limit. Auto-reconnect has stopped.

appearance.languageHelp: Applies immediately and is remembered on this device.

audio.inputHelp: Used to capture your voice. You can switch at any time.
audio.outputHelp: Applied to all incoming voice immediately.
audio.levelHelp: The green bar moves with your voice.
audio.gainHelp: Only changes how loud you sound to others.
audio.outputVolumeHelp: Global volume. Per-person volume is in the member list.
audio.lowLatencyHelp: Favors lower delay. Turn it off if audio breaks up on an unstable network.
audio.permissionNeeded: Microphone access is needed to list devices

voice.triggerHelp: Auto follows the room noise. Manual uses a fixed level.
voice.thresholdHelp: Sending starts above this level and stops about 0.35s after you stop.
voice.dragToManual: Drag the slider to switch to manual
voice.continuousHelp: For music, testing, or an always-open mic. Off by default.
voice.continuousWarning: This keeps your microphone open and other members will always see you talking. Only turn it on when needed.

diagnostics.title: Connection diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Use this to investigate delay or disconnects. Copy it and send it to the maintainer.

about.note: Mumble Web · your Mumble voice space in the browser.
about.logoutConfirm: You will return to the connect screen. Continue?

shell.channelsDescription: Choose a voice channel to view or join

errors.pageBody: The error was logged. Reload the page to try again.
errors.proxyDisconnected: The connection to the proxy server was lost.
errors.proxyUnreachable: Could not reach the proxy server. If you are using an online preview, its gateway may not support WebSocket; deploy with Docker instead.
errors.reconnectFailed: The connection was lost and automatic reconnection failed. Try again manually.
errors.missingCredentials: Reconnection credentials are missing. Please connect again.
errors.micSwitch: Could not switch the input device.
errors.usernameInUse: That name is already in use. Try another one.
errors.kicked: You were removed from the server.
errors.banned: You are banned from this server.
errors.serverFull: The server is full. Try again later.
errors.tls: Could not verify the server certificate.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or already used.
errors.resumeInvalid: This recovery link is no longer valid. Use the invite link again.
errors.serverOverrideDenied: This proxy does not allow choosing another server.
errors.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address, port, and network.
errors.webrtcFailed: Could not start the voice channel.
errors.invalidUsername: That name is not valid. Try another one.
errors.versionMismatch: This client version is not compatible with the server.
